description: Racing-pigeon clock record directory: loft number (棚号), gate (门), time (时刻), open/close (开闭), ring read (读环) and explicit empty ring (空环). A close on the exit beam records one official arrival; a missing ring field means only that some competing pigeon passed; an explicit null means the non-competing empty-ring model.

fields.name: gate
fields.description: 门 gate/beam id; the clock room maps ids to roles (entry beam 入门梁 / exit beam 出门梁)

fields.name: time
fields.description: 时刻 event time in clock ticks

fields.name: action
fields.description: 开闭 0=open 开, 1=close 合; only a close marks a beam crossing

fields.name: ring
fields.description: 读环 named foot ring scanned by the antenna at this cross-section; absent means the read is missing (只知道有鸽)

fields.name: empty_ring
fields.description: 空环 explicit null: the crossing pigeon is the non-competing empty-ring model
